project.name: MissionChief Map Command Toolkit
project.tagline: Native map command, fleet identity, transport support and financial intelligence for MissionChief.
project.description: A configurable userscript focused on native MissionChief map command, mission-age timers, vehicle identity, transport support, geographic utilities, financial reconciliation and responsive layouts.

sections.heading: The One We Knew Before
sections.body: Version 7 removes the copied requirements, call-window, call-list and enhanced transport-request engines completely. Their settings, stored state, observers, scheduling and DOM rewriting no longer initialise.

sections.heading: What remains
sections.body: Mission Age map timers, Mission Value, native Patient Transport Sweep, Transport Watcher, Resource Gap, vehicle identity, map utilities, financial intelligence, themes and responsive layouts remain supported.

sections.heading: Settings migration
sections.body: Existing retained settings load normally. Obsolete mission-window settings are discarded during state normalisation without requiring a full reset.

sections.heading: Install through TKB
sections.body: Install Tampermonkey or a compatible userscript manager, open the official TKB Toolkit page, review permissions and confirm installation. The TKB Website is the only supported installation and automatic-update channel.

sections.heading: First launch
sections.body: Open MissionChief and use the map command button. Core controls load first; larger panels and monitors are constructed only when required.

sections.heading: Persistent controls
sections.body: Feature state, theme, operating mode and toolbar state are retained. Export settings before substantial browser or device changes.

sections.heading: Map-first behaviour
sections.body: The Toolkit adds summaries, overlays and shortcuts around MissionChief rather than replacing its native mission windows or mission list.

sections.heading: Mission Age map timers
sections.body: Compact timer badges appear above personal missions and can be toggled with shortcut 6.

sections.heading: Mission Value
sections.body: Mission Value displays a verified value, hides unavailable values and stays clear of native controls.

sections.heading: Transport Watcher
sections.body: Transport Watcher identifies patient or prisoner transport-required missions without replacing MissionChief controls.

sections.heading: Patient Transport Sweep
sections.body: The manual bounded alliance workflow discovers current missions from live map markers or, on iOS, a deliberate current-payload refresh; fallback entries require positive alliance ownership. It excludes the signed-in player's vehicles and uses MissionChief's native vehicle-window discharge control for one verified eligible ambulance at a time. Its final aggregate report persists until dismissed or replaced; when a valid Discord webhook is already saved, the same privacy-safe snapshot posts once automatically and delivery failure never changes the sweep result.

sections.heading: Resource Gap
sections.body: Compares mission demand with personal vehicle context inside a configurable radius.

sections.heading: Coverage rings
sections.body: Coverage rings provide geographic range context without installing a document-wide heat overlay.

sections.heading: Smart Bookmark Labels
sections.body: Automatically shortens labels while retaining the full name through tooltips or touch previews.

sections.heading: Financial intelligence
sections.body: Reconciles income, spending and variance and can send Simple, Informative or The Wolf reports to a saved Discord webhook.

sections.heading: Import and export
sections.body: Move configuration between Desktop, Tablet and iOS. Exports may contain a saved Discord webhook and must remain private.

sections.heading: Reset strategy
sections.body: Export first, reset only the affected feature where possible and test with the default Map Command interface before a full reset.

troubleshooting.problem: MissionChief feels slow immediately after page load
steps: Confirm the installed version is current
Enable Economy Mode on lower-power devices
Compare with the Toolkit disabled and capture startup metrics

troubleshooting.problem: A button or panel is missing
steps: Check whether the toolbar is collapsed
Report browser, userscript manager and Toolkit versions

troubleshooting.problem: A native mission or vehicle control is unavailable
steps: Allow the MissionChief window to finish loading
Confirm the control is visible without the Toolkit
Reload the active mission or vehicle window once
Report the exact route and missing native control

troubleshooting.problem: Settings did not carry to another device

knownIssues.title: No release-blocking issue is recorded for the current verified release
knownIssues.body: Release channels and integrity state remain visible on the status page and in GitHub.

knownIssues.title: MissionChief interface changes can affect selectors
knownIssues.body: A live MissionChief markup change may require a userscript update even where static selector contracts remain green.

knownIssues.title: Large overlays have a deliberate performance cost
knownIssues.body: Coverage and monitoring systems should be enabled when operationally useful rather than left active on low-power devices.
